verdict: For a normal serving, 1 karipap is lighter, an estimated ~130 kcal compared to 2 fried popia at ~200 kcal. If you only take one popia, the difference is small.
why: 1 karipap is an estimated ~130 kcal, 2 fried popia ~200 kcal.
One popia on its own is an estimated ~100 kcal. So what matters is how many you take.
Protein is similarly low: karipap 3 g, popia 4 g for 2 rolls.
Popia are small and crispy, so it's easy to keep adding one more without noticing.
when_a: Karipap is okay for afternoon tea. One potato-filled karipap is enough to fill the gap.
when_b: Fried popia is okay when breaking fast or at events. Take 1-2 rolls and pair them with vegetables or fruit.
tip: Put fried kuih on a small plate, don't eat straight from the plastic bag. When you can see how many you've had, it's easier to stop.

faq.q: Is sardine karipap better than potato karipap?
faq.a: Sardine filling has a bit more protein, so it may be more filling. Calories are about the same because the pastry is still fried.
Usually yes, because it isn't fried and has more vegetables. It's a good choice if it's available.
